name: draw-large-flow
note: Draw this flow, business variant, on an 80-element synthetic order-fulfilment flow. The contract asks for 8 to 15 nodes; the eval allows 6 to 18, because the count is a contract property, not a grounding one. Every API-looking name in the picture must exist in the flow.
